exercises.explanationUz:
BU NIMA?
Har to'rt unitdan keyin MODUL TESTI keladi. U unit emas —
o'zingizni sinash uchun test.

BALLAR TAQSIMOTI (jami 100):
  1-mashq  — mamlakat va millat        10 ball
  2-mashq  — so'z qo'yish              10 ball
  3-mashq  — to'g'ri variantni tanlash 10 ball
  4-mashq  — predloglar                 8 ball
  5-mashq  — fe'l shakllari             8 ball
  6-mashq  — olmoshlar                  6 ball
  7-mashq  — egalik ('s / s')           5 ball
  8-mashq  — savol-javob moslash        7 ball
  9-mashq  — o'qish va savollar        10 ball
  10-mashq — ortiqcha so'zni topish     8 ball
  11-mashq — odam tavsifi yozish       18 ball

QANDAY ISHLATISH:
  1) Avval hech narsaga qaramasdan bajaring
  2) Keyin javoblarni tekshiring
  3) Xato qilgan mavzuni O'SHA unitdan qaytadan ko'ring

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct country or nationality. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri mamlakat yoki millat nomini yozing. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAMLAKAT ↔ MILLAT (Unit 1 mavzusi).

MILLAT QO'SHIMCHALARI:
  -an / -ian:  Argentina → Argentinian, Mexico → Mexican,
               Brazil → Brazilian, Canada → Canadian
  -ish:        Spain → Spanish, Turkey → Turkish,
               Finland → Finnish, Scotland → Scottish
  -ese:        Japan → Japanese, China → Chinese
  -k / boshqa: Greece → Greek

DIQQAT: millat nomi HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi —
o'zbek tilida bunday qoida yo'q!
  ✅ He is Spanish.   ❌ He is spanish.

items.textEn: 1  Argentina →
items.whyUz: Argentina + -ian. Janubiy Amerika mamlakati.

items.textEn: 2  ____ → Brazilian
items.whyUz: Brazilian dan orqaga: Brazil (Braziliya).

items.textEn: 3  Spain →
items.whyUz: Spain + -ish. Til nomi ham 'Spanish'.

items.textEn: 4  Mexico →
items.whyUz: Mexico + -an, 'o' tushadi.

items.textEn: 5  ____ → Greek
items.whyUz: Greek dan orqaga: Greece (Yunoniston). Millat 'Greek' — noodatiy shakl.

items.textEn: 6  ____ → Finnish
items.whyUz: Finnish dan orqaga: Finland (Finlyandiya). 'Finland' → 'Finnish' — 'land' tushadi.

items.textEn: 7  Turkey →
items.whyUz: Turkey + -ish, 'ey' tushadi. DIQQAT: 'turkey' kichik harf bilan — kurka (parranda).

items.textEn: 8  ____ → Canadian
items.whyUz: Canadian dan orqaga: Canada (Kanada).

items.textEn: 9  Japan →
items.whyUz: Japan + -ese. Til nomi ham 'Japanese'.

items.textEn: 10  ____ → Scottish
items.whyUz: Scottish dan orqaga: Scotland (Shotlandiya). Odam esa 'a Scot'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI:
  hear, near, going, College, dancer, spacious,
  cheap, e-mail, yellowish, view

Har bir so'z FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Gapning ma'nosiga va grammatikasiga qarang:
  • 'a ____ living-room' — sifat kerak
  • 'loves ____ to the cinema' — -ing shakli kerak
  • 'She is a ____' — ot kerak

items.textEn: 1  Downstairs, there is a ____ living-room.
items.whyUz: Otdan oldin SIFAT kerak. spacious = keng (Unit 3).

items.textEn: 2  Tony loves ____ to the cinema.
items.whyUz: 'love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi (Unit 4).

items.textEn: 3  Please be my ____ pal.
items.whyUz: 'e-mail pal' — elektron pochta orqali yozishadigan do'st. 'pen pal' ning zamonaviy varianti.

items.textEn: 4  Hope to ____ from you soon.
items.whyUz: 'hear from somebody' = kimdandir xabar olmoq. Xat oxiridagi standart ibora.

items.textEn: 5  Rashid is a student at Mortimer ____ .
items.whyUz: O'quv yurti nomi — katta harf bilan. 'at ... College' — muassasada.

items.textEn: 6  Bob's house is ____ the city centre.
items.whyUz: 'near' = yaqin. Predlogsiz ishlatiladi ('near from' XATO).

items.textEn: 7  We have got a wonderful ____ from our balcony.
items.whyUz: 'a wonderful view' — ajoyib manzara (Unit 3).

items.textEn: 8  This modern flat is a bargain. It's really very ____ .
items.whyUz: 'bargain' = arzon taklif → demak narxi arzon (cheap).

items.textEn: 9  Mary is quite tall and slim. She is a ____ .
items.whyUz: Baland va nozik gavda → raqqosa. 'dance' + er.

items.textEn: 10  Chinese people have usually got a ____ complexion.
items.whyUz: 'yellow' + -ish = sarg'ish. '-ish' rang nomiga qo'shilsa 'ozgina o'sha rangda' ma'nosini beradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
1–4-unitlarning lug'ati aralash:
  Unit 1 — kasblar, millatlar
  Unit 2 — tashqi ko'rinish (soch, ko'z, teri)
  Unit 3 — uy jihozlari
  Unit 4 — qarindoshlik, xarakter

Har bir bandda gapning MA'NOSIGA qarang.

items.textEn: 1  Beth isn't a very good student. She's very ____ .
items.whyUz: Yaxshi o'qimaslikning sababi — dangasalik. 'rude' (qo'pol) va 'clever' (aqlli) mos emas.

items.textEn: 2  Mr Cline works at the hospital. He is a(n) ____ .
items.whyUz: Kasalxonada — jarroh (surgeon). Muhandis va musiqachi kasalxonada ishlamaydi.

items.textEn: 3  Is Jane's hair grey? No, it's ____ .
items.whyUz: Soch RANGI so'ralgan. 'wavy' — shakl (to'lqinsimon), 'yellow' esa soch uchun ishlatilmaydi — 'fair' yoki 'blonde' deyiladi.

items.textEn: 4  There are two ____ in the bathroom.
items.whyUz: Hammomda oyna bo'ladi. Divan — mehmonxonada, plita — oshxonada.

items.textEn: 5  "____ magazine is that?" "It's Karen's."
items.whyUz: Keyin OT ('magazine') keladi va javob egalik ('Karen's') → Whose.

items.textEn: 6  My sister goes to primary school. She's very ____ .
items.whyUz: Boshlang'ich maktab — 5–11 yosh → yosh (young).

items.textEn: 7  Kim is my sister's daughter. She's my ____ .
items.whyUz: Opa-singilning QIZI — niece (qiz jiyan). 'nephew' — o'g'il jiyan.

items.textEn: 8  People from Sweden have got ____ .
items.whyUz: Shvetsiya — Shimoliy Yevropa → oq (och) teri. 'slanting eyes' — Sharqiy Osiyo, 'dark brown skin' — Afrika.

items.textEn: 9  There is a big ____ in the kitchen.
items.whyUz: Oshxonada 'sink' (idish yuviladigan joy). 'washbasin' — hammomda, 'bookcase' — ish xonasida.

items.textEn: 10  I like my teacher. She's always very ____ .
items.whyUz: 'I like my teacher' — ijobiy. Demak ijobiy sifat kerak: patient (sabrli).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing preposition. (8 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1–4-unitlardagi barcha predloglar aralash:

  OF   — 'the capital of', qism
  WITH — tashqi ko'rinish tavsifi
  FROM — kelib chiqish
  IN   — bino, xona ichida
  ON   — devor, yuza
  AT   — muassasa
  BEHIND — orqasida

Rasmda Praga — Chexiya poytaxti ko'rsatilgan.

items.textEn: 1  Prague is the capital ____ the Czech Republic.
items.whyUz: 'the capital OF' — turg'un birikma. Praga — Chexiya poytaxti.

items.textEn: 2  He is well-built ____ short fair hair.
items.whyUz: Tashqi ko'rinish tavsifida WITH.

items.textEn: 3  My pen pal is ____ Canada.
items.whyUz: Kelib chiqish uchun FROM (Unit 1).

items.textEn: 4  John lives ____ a huge block of flats.
items.whyUz: Bino ICHIDA yashaydi → IN.

items.textEn: 5  There is a lovely poster ____ the wall.
items.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsa uchun doim ON.

items.textEn: 6  Is there a fireplace ____ the living-room?
items.whyUz: Xona ichida → IN.

items.textEn: 7  My father works ____ the local hospital.
items.whyUz: Muassasa bilan AT: work AT the hospital.

items.textEn: 8  The garden is ____ the house.
items.whyUz: Bog' odatda uyning ORQASIDA. 'in front of' ham bo'lishi mumkin, lekin britan uylarida bog' orqada.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs in brackets. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shaklini qo'ying. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH XIL FE'L aralash:

  'to be'    — am / is / are
  'have got' — have got / has got
  oddiy fe'l — Present Simple (-s, do/does, don't/doesn't)

HAR BIRIDA BOSHQA QOIDA:
  to be:      savol — fe'l oldinga chiqadi (Where IS Juan from?)
  have got:   savol — 'Has he got ...?', inkor — 'hasn't got'
  oddiy fe'l: savol — 'Does he live?', inkor — 'doesn't live'

'to be' va 'have got' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI!

lines.whyUz: 'to be' savolda oldinga chiqadi: Where IS Juan from? 'does' KERAK EMAS.
'like' oddiy fe'l → DO you like. 'like' dan keyin -ING (swimming).
3-shaxs birlik 'have got' inkori → hasn't got. 'doesn't have' ham bo'ladi.

lines.textEn: Helen usually ____ (watch) TV in the afternoons ...

lines.whyUz: 3-shaxs birlik savoli → DOES Philip LIVE (fe'l -s siz).

lines.textEn: My father ____ (not/get up) early on Saturdays.
lines.whyUz: doesn't + asos shakl. 'on Saturdays' — har shanba.
'to be' oldinga chiqadi: IS it a big house?

lines.textEn: Yes, there ____ (be) eight rooms in it.

groups.explanationUz: Millat nomi HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi.
Rangga -ish qo'shilsa, 'ozgina o'sha rangda' ma'nosini beradi.

items.derived: Hope to hear from you soon.

patterns.formula: X is the capital OF + mamlakat.
patterns.exampleEn: Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic.
patterns.explanationUz: 'the capital OF' — turg'un birikma, boshqa predlog ishlatilmaydi.

patterns.formula: Where is + ISM + from? — He/She is from + mamlakat.
patterns.exampleEn: Where is Juan from? — He is from Spain.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to be' fe'li savolda OLDINGA chiqadi — 'does' kerak emas.
'from' gap oxirida qoladi.

patterns.formula: Do/Does + ega + fe'l + ...? — Yes, ... do/does. / No, ... don't/doesn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Does Philip live in Madrid? — Yes, he does.
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan do/does kerak. Fe'l -s olmaydi.

patterns.formula: somebody hasn't got + ... . He/She has got + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Jenny hasn't got curly hair. She has got straight hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Jennining sochi jingalak emas. Uning sochi tekis.
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI — 'has' o'zi inkorni oladi.

patterns.formula: X is + sifat, BUT Y isn't.
patterns.exampleEn: My English teacher is very patient, but my Maths teacher isn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Ingliz tili o'qituvchim juda sabrli, lekin matematika o'qituvchim yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi qismda sifat TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat 'isn't' qoladi.

patterns.formula: Is it a + sifat + ot? — Yes, there are + son + rooms in it.
patterns.exampleEn: Is it a big house? — Yes, there are eight rooms in it.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu katta uymi? — Ha, unda sakkizta xona bor.
